title: A Visit to the Cafe
text:
Maria goes to a small cafe with her mother. The menu has soup, bread and salad. Maria wants a sandwich and a glass of milk. The price of the sandwich is five dollars.

Her mother orders tea and a piece of cake. They sit by the window and talk about their day. After lunch, they pay at the counter and say thank you to the waiter.

questions.text: What does Maria want to eat?

options: Tea and a piece of cake

questions.text: Why do Maria and her mother probably like the cafe?
options: It is a comfortable place to talk and eat
It is very large and noisy
It has no food on the menu
It is far from their home

questions.text: Where do Maria and her mother probably pay for their lunch?

paragraph_translations: Марія ходить у маленьку кав'ярню зі своєю мамою. У меню є суп, хліб і салат. Марія хоче бутерброд і склянку молока. Ціна бутерброда — п'ять доларів.
Її мама замовляє чай і шматок торта. Вони сидять біля вікна і розмовляють про свій день. Після обіду вони платять на прилавку і дякують офіціанту.
